column1: # The absent -> present -> present transcript `pb`'s ensure driver must produce.
# AUTHORED, NOT CAPTURED. Every row below is derived from two doctrine sections and
#   substrate_doctrine.md section 6 fixes the order of the pre-binary steps -- ensure
#   the package-manager root's tool (ghcup), then resolve and install the compatible
#   GHC and Cabal through it, then the cluster tools.
#   substrate_doctrine.md section 3 fixes the shape of each step -- probe, install if
#   absent, resolve the absolute path, invoke by it -- and makes the probe the
#   post-condition, which is why every pass ends in five post-condition probes rather
#   than in an install's exit code.
# The property this file exists to decide is not "pass one looks like this". It is
# that **pass two and pass three carry probes and no mutation at all**. A driver that
# reported converged without probing produces a pass with no probe rows; a driver
# whose second run mutates produces a pass with a mutation row. Both are seeded
# mutants, and each reddens exactly one check.
# `$HOME` is the run-local fake home. It is elided so this file compares against a
# run rather than against the temporary directory one run happened to use.
